title: Tech View and Board View offer a Technician filter that List does not
custom_preconds:
• Owner/Admin with Work Orders View and Create & Edit permissions at the test location; browser width at least 1024 px.
  • Three active, clockable technicians eligible for groups/columns: A = Ana Carter (created first), B = Ana Brooks (created after A), C = Ben Adams (created after B). Equivalent names may be used if they exercise the same first-name/last-name ordering.
  • One Approved work order led by A. Clear filters and search; turn Assigned to me off.

Source: PRD v60, S1-R15, S1-R15b and Out of Scope.

Execution dependency: The Technician filter must be available. The latest execution is blocked by SV-11326 (Open, checked 16 Oct 2026). Rerun when available; automation remains on hold pending execution.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders → All → Tech View. Note the unfiltered technician groups and inspect the filter bar.
  2. Open the Technician filter and inspect its options and order.
  3. Select A and B.
  4. Clear the Technician selection. Switch to Board View and inspect the filter bar and Technician options against the unfiltered columns.
  5. Switch to List and inspect the filter bar.
custom_expected:
Step 1: The Technician filter appears immediately after Assigned to me. Department, Customer and Service Advisor filters are absent.

Step 2: Unassigned appears first. The remaining options match the location’s Tech View groups and are sorted by first name, then last name: B before A before C, regardless of creation order.

Step 3: A and B can both remain selected at the same time.

Step 4: Board View has the same filter placement, eligible options and sort order as Tech View; options match its unfiltered columns. Department, Customer and Service Advisor filters are absent.

Step 5: List has no Technician filter.
